environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda. Split.io SDK configured with API key 'sdk-staging-xyz789'. The workspace has a targeting rule on flag 'doc-upload-restrict-types' where the default rule for environment 'staging-gated' returns treatment 'on' with 100% allocation, and the flag's kill switch is disabled. The Split relay proxy (v5.4.1) runs as a sidecar in the same VPC with local evaluation cache, ensuring flag evaluation does not depend on external network calls. The treatment 'on' activates the isAllowedFileType() check which restricts uploads to .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .png, .jpg, .jpeg extensions only.
